title: Initiative intent
summary: The shared statement of what an initiative is for: one document every workflow reads, each stage writing its own sections and suggesting changes to the rest.

depth.note: How far the thinking has got, in the intent framework's words (frameworks/intent.md)

sections.heading: Goal
sections.guide: One in-market goal, in a sentence. The same line as the card's goal.

sections.heading: Problem
sections.guide: The problem in the users' words, with the evidence ids from the registers (E-01).

sections.heading: Customer
sections.guide: Who it is for, and the situation they are in when it matters.

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.guide: What is different if it works, and the measure.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.guide: What is in, and what is deliberately out.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.guide: What we are building, pointing at the PRD or requirements catalog by artifact id.

sections.heading: Dependencies
sections.guide: What it relies on and who owns each, pointing at the dependency board.

sections.heading: Delivery
sections.guide: Where it stands against the date, the truth first.
